recent_posts.title: Expo Go, Ease, Screen Transitions, LegendList, JSI, Gradle, Radon, Baguette, Rozenite, AI

recent_posts.title: This Week In React #279: Compiler, TSRX, StyleX, XState, Hook Form, TanStack, shadcn, Chakra, Inertia, Mantine

Key releases include React Hook Form 7.74, Chakra UI 3.35, Mantine 9.1, TanStack Query 5.100, XState 5.31, StyleX 0.18, and shadcn CLI 4.5. The 'Other' section covers pnpm 11.0 with SQLite-backed store, Node.js v26 upcoming release, CSS scroll-driven animations, and the Aube package manager.
